item.text:
<linkedin_post>Thrive Holdings is placing ADT at the center of its smart home security business after acquiring the company for $10 per share. The deal values ADT’s equity at about $7.6 billion and has a total enterprise value of $15.3 billion.

The acquisition gives Thrive a place in a market where Amazon has introduced AI-powered home cameras and Apple has entered with new smart home and security products. ADT already works with Apple and Google, and those partnerships are expected to continue.

OpenAI is an investor in Thrive and supplies its companies with AI technology and engineers. Thrive and ADT plan to invest in new products, though they have not announced what those products will be.</linkedin_post>
